# Benjamin Arnedo

> Photographer & Cinematographer based in Brisbane, Australia.

Benjamin Arnedo works at the intersection of editorial photography and narrative filmmaking. His practice spans commercial, documentary, and artistic projects, with a focus on light, motion, and the decisive moment.
